title: Jitter Partners
summary: Discover the latest features, updates and improvements of Jitter, the fast and simple motion design tool on the web. Try Jitter for free now.
body_markdown:
You can now earn with Jitter through the[Jitter Partners program](https://jitter.video/partners) : great for content creators, motion design educators, and designers building their own template collections. Share Jitter with your audience or community and earn a 50% commission on every customer you refer, for 12 months.


Here’s how you can join the program:


1. Head to the[application page](https://jitter.video/partners) .
2. Fill in your details and add your website or social media.
3. Tell us how you plan to promote Jitter, whether that’s tutorials, posts, or your own animation templates.


From there, we'll review your application. Once you're approved, you'll get a unique referral link you can start sharing with your audience right away.
